blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Today, visit the Argentine side of the falls, again with an English-speaking guide. Entrance tickets are included.

The trails follow walkways and viewing platforms above the tropical rainforest, home to orchids, birds, reptiles and other local flora and fauna. The Argentine side brings you closer to individual cascades and lets you see the falls from a different angle.

One of the main parts of the tour begins with a ride on the ecological train, followed by a walk to the Devil’s Throat viewing platform. From here, you can see the most powerful cascade in the complex, with the greatest volume of water. The roar of the falls, clouds of spray and the surrounding rainforest create one of the most memorable scenes of the journey.
